step-1994-p1-q1.summary: A rectangular floor of dimensions $2q$ by $2p$, where $q>p>0$, is covered by a hipped roof. Each of the four roof planes rises inwards from one edge at the same angle $\theta$ to the floor, where $0<\theta<\pi/2$. Find the ridge length, the enclosed attic volume and the area of all four roof faces; explain why the first answer is independent of pitch.
step-1994-p1-q1.summaryZh: 长、宽为 $2q,2p$（$q>p>0$）的矩形地面上盖有四坡屋顶。四个斜平面分别从地面的四条边以相同倾角 $\theta$ 向内升高，$0<\theta<\pi/2$。求屋脊长度、阁楼容积和四块屋面总面积，并说明屋脊长为何与坡度无关。
step-1994-p1-q1.answerZh: 屋脊长 $2(q-p)$，容积为 $\frac23p^2(3q-p)\tan\theta$，屋面总面积是 $4pq\sec\theta$。

methods.title: Integrate horizontal sections
steps: At height $z$ the four roof planes have advanced a horizontal distance $t=z\cot\theta$ from their respective edges. The section is consequently a rectangle with sides $2(p-t)$ and $2(q-t)$. The shorter side first vanishes at $t=p$, giving height $p\tan\theta$ and a remaining segment of length $2(q-p)$. Pitch changes height but not this inset distance.

Since $dz=\tan\theta\,dt$, the volume is $4\tan\theta\int_0^p(p-t)(q-t)\,dt=\frac23p^2(3q-p)\tan\theta$. Each roof face projects onto the floor with area factor $\cos\theta$. The four projections tile the whole floor, so the surface area is $4pq/\cos\theta$.
stepsZh: 在高度 $z$ 处，每个斜平面都从相应的地面边水平内缩 $t=z\cot\theta$，故截面长、宽为 $2(q-t),2(p-t)$。当 $t=p$ 时短边首次缩为零，此时高度为 $p\tan\theta$，余下的线段长 $2(q-p)$。倾角影响高度，却不改变所需内缩距离。
由 $dz=\tan\theta\,dt$，体积为 $4\tan\theta\int_0^p(p-t)(q-t)\,dt=\frac23p^2(3q-p)\tan\theta$。每块屋面投影到地面时，面积乘以 $\cos\theta$；四个投影刚好铺满矩形，故总面积为 $4pq/\cos\theta$。

methods.title: Split into a prism and two half-pyramids
methods.titleZh: 分割为棱柱和两个半棱锥
steps: The midpoint of each short end is horizontally $p$ from a long side at the centreline. A roof point lies on the ridge once it is at least $p$ from either end; hence the ridge runs between the positions $p$ and $2q-p$ along the centreline. Its height is $H=p\tan\theta$.

The portion between the ridge endpoints is a prism of length $2(q-p)$ with triangular section of base $2p$ and height $H$. The two end portions, joined at their straight cut faces, form a square pyramid of base side $2p$ and the same height. Adding gives $2(q-p)pH+4p^2H/3$. Each sloping face has area equal to its floor projection times $\sec\theta$, giving the stated area.
stepsZh: 在地面纵向中线上，每一点离长边的距离都是 $p$。当它离两端也都至少有 $p$ 时，其正上方就是屋脊，故屋脊沿纵向从位置 $p$ 延伸到 $2q-p$，高度为 $H=p\tan\theta$。
两脊端之间是长 $2(q-p)$ 的三棱柱，截面三角形底为 $2p$、高为 $H$。两端余下的部分沿竖直切面拼合，恰为底边长 $2p$、高为 $H$ 的正四棱锥。因此总体积为 $2(q-p)pH+4p^2H/3$。每块屋面面积等于地面投影面积乘以 $\sec\theta$，相加即得所求总面积。

step-1994-p1-q3.summary: For a nonnegative integer $n$, determine $S_n=\sum_{k=0}^n(-1)^k\binom nk^2$. Give the expression separately for odd and even $n$.
step-1994-p1-q3.summaryZh: 对非负整数 $n$，求交错和 $S_n=\sum_{k=0}^n(-1)^k\binom nk^2$，分别说明 $n$ 为奇数和偶数时的结果。

methods.title: Identify one coefficient in two expansions
steps: The coefficient of $x^n$ in $(1-x)^n(1+x)^n$ is $\sum_{k=0}^n(-1)^k\binom nk\binom n{n-k}=S_n$. But the product is $(1-x^2)^n$, which has no terms of odd degree. In degree $n=2m$, choose the $-x^2$ term from $m$ factors to obtain $(-1)^m\binom{2m}{m}$.
stepsZh: 在 $(1-x)^n(1+x)^n$ 中，$x^n$ 的系数是 $\sum_{k=0}^n(-1)^k\binom nk\binom n{n-k}=S_n$。另一方面，原乘积等于 $(1-x^2)^n$，不含奇次项。若 $n=2m$，要取到 $x^{2m}$ 须从 $m$ 个因子中取 $-x^2$，所以系数为 $(-1)^m\binom{2m}{m}$。

methods.title: Cancel marked subsets in pairs
methods.titleZh: 将带符号的子集配对抵消
steps: Create $n$ labelled pairs, each with one red and one blue object. Choose $n$ of the $2n$ objects and assign the choice the sign $(-1)^k$ if $k$ red objects were chosen. The sum of the signs is $S_n$.

Whenever some pair contributes exactly one object, find the first such pair and interchange the chosen colour in it. This reverses the sign and is its own inverse, so all such choices cancel. In a surviving choice every pair contributes either two or zero. This is impossible if $n$ is odd; if $n=2m$, exactly $m$ complete pairs are chosen, each surviving choice has $m$ red objects, and their signed count is $(-1)^m\binom{2m}{m}$.
stepsZh: 构造 $n$ 对带编号的物品，每对各有一红一蓝。任选 $n$ 件，若其中有 $k$ 件红色物品，就赋予符号 $(-1)^k$。所有符号的和正是 $S_n$。
若某一对恰有一个成员被选，找出编号最小的这种物品对，改选它的另一种颜色。该操作使符号反转，且重复两次回到原状，因此这类选择全部抵消。剩下的选择中，每对只能全选或全不选。奇数 $n$ 时不可能有这种选择；当 $n=2m$ 时，要全选 $m$ 对，每种选择恰有 $m$ 件红色物品，故带符号总数为 $(-1)^m\binom{2m}{m}$。

step-1994-p1-q7.summary: Split the positive integers in order into blocks of lengths $1,3,5,7,\ldots$. The first four block sums are $0^3+1^3$, $1^3+2^3$, $2^3+3^3$, $3^3+4^3$. Find and prove the rule for every block, then deduce the sum of the first $N$ positive cubes.
step-1994-p1-q7.summaryZh: 将正整数依次分成长为 $1,3,5,7,\ldots$ 的若干组。前四组的和分别等于 $0^3+1^3,1^3+2^3,2^3+3^3,3^3+4^3$。猜想并证明第 $k$ 组的求和规律，再推出前 $N$ 个正整数的立方和。
step-1994-p1-q7.answer: The $k$th block sums to $(k-1)^3+k^3$; consequently $\sum_{k=1}^N k^3=[N(N+1)/2]^2$.

methods.title: Add arithmetic blocks twice
steps: The first $k$ odd block lengths sum to $k^2$ since $j^2-(j-1)^2=2j-1$. Thus block $k$ consists of the integers from $(k-1)^2+1$ through $k^2$. Its $2k-1$ terms have average $k^2-k+1$, giving sum $(2k-1)(k^2-k+1)=(k-1)^3+k^3$.

The first $N$ blocks together sum to $N^2(N^2+1)/2$. Their cube expressions count every positive cube below $N^3$ twice and count $N^3$ once. If $C_N=\sum_{k=1}^N k^3$, this yields $2C_N-N^3=N^2(N^2+1)/2$. Solving gives $C_N=N^2(N+1)^2/4$.
stepsZh: 前 $N$ 组之和又是 $N^2(N^2+1)/2$。把各组和写成立方和，每个小于 $N^3$ 的正立方计两次，$N^3$ 仅计一次。若 $C_N=\sum_{k=1}^N k^3$，则 $2C_N-N^3=N^2(N^2+1)/2$，解得 $C_N=N^2(N+1)^2/4$。

methods.title: Use differences of triangular numbers
steps: Let $T_j=j(j+1)/2$. Since the $k$th block begins just after $(k-1)^2$ and ends at $k^2$, its sum is $T_{k^2}-T_{(k-1)^2}=(2k-1)(k^2-k+1)=(k-1)^3+k^3$.
For the second claim, $T_j-T_{j-1}=j$ and $T_j+T_{j-1}=j^2$. Multiplying shows $T_j^2-T_{j-1}^2=j^3$. Summing from $1$ through $N$ cancels every intermediate square, leaving $T_N^2$.
stepsZh: 对立方和，注意 $T_j-T_{j-1}=j$ 且 $T_j+T_{j-1}=j^2$。相乘得到 $T_j^2-T_{j-1}^2=j^3$。从 $1$ 加到 $N$ 后，中间的平方项均抵消，剩下 $T_N^2$。

step-1994-p1-q12.summary: An applicant randomly ranks three different colleges from a list of $28$; exactly two, $A$ and $B$, have a particular designation. Compute (i) the chance of a designated first choice, (ii) the chance of listing $A$, (iii) the chance of listing at least one of $A,B$, and the following conditional chances: (iv) listing $B$ given $A$ is first; (v) listing $B$ given $A$ appears; (vi) listing both given the first choice is designated; (vii) listing both given at least one designated college appears anywhere.
step-1994-p1-q12.summaryZh: 从 $28$ 所学院中等可能地选出不同的三所并排序，其中仅 $A,B$ 两所有指定属性。求以下概率：（i）第一志愿有该属性；（ii）选中 $A$；（iii）至少选中 $A,B$ 之一。再求条件概率：（iv）已知首选 $A$，还选到 $B$；（v）已知选中 $A$，还选到 $B$；（vi）已知首选有指定属性，两所都被选中；（vii）已知任一位置上至少选中这两所之一，两所都被选中。

methods.title: Condition on a specified choice or on an event
methods.titleZh: 区分指定学院与至少一个事件
steps: For (i) there are $2$ designated options out of $28$, giving $1/14$. In (ii), by symmetry each college appears with probability $3/28$. For (iii), subtract the chance of choosing only ordinary colleges: $1-\binom{26}{3}/\binom{28}{3}=13/63$.

For (iv) the two open positions contain a uniformly chosen pair from the remaining $27$; the chance of including $B$ is $2/27$. In (v), disregard the order. Among three-element sets already containing $A$, the other two colleges still form a uniform pair from $27$, giving $2/27$. For (vi), condition further on which designated college is first. Both cases reduce to (iv), hence again $2/27$.

For (vii), the conditioning event includes all three-element sets with one or two designated colleges. There are $2\binom{26}{2}+26=676$ such sets, and just $26$ with both. Their ratio is $1/26$. This condition does not specify the name or the position of any chosen college.
stepsZh: （i）首选有 $28$ 种，其中有指定属性的有 $2$ 种，故概率为 $1/14$。（ii）按对称性，每所学院出现在三个位置之一的概率为 $3/28$。（iii）减去三所均为普通学院的概率，得到 $1-\binom{26}{3}/\binom{28}{3}=13/63$。
（iv）余下两个位置从另外 $27$ 所中等可能地选两所，含 $B$ 的概率为 $2/27$。（v）忽略顺序，在已经含有 $A$ 的三元子集中，另外两所仍是从 $27$ 所中等可能地选出的二元子集，故仍为 $2/27$。（vi）再按第一志愿究竟是 $A$ 还是 $B$ 分类，两类都化为（iv），所以还是 $2/27$。
（vii）给定的仅是三元子集中至少有一所指定学院。含恰好一所或两所指定学院的集合共有 $2\binom{26}{2}+26=676$ 个，含两所的有 $26$ 个，故概率为 $1/26$。此条件既没有指明学院名称，也没有指明其志愿顺序。

step-1994-p1-q2.summary: For a constant $a$, differentiate with respect to $x$: (i) $x^a$; (ii) $a^x$; (iii) $x^x$; (iv) $x^{(x^x)}$; (v) $(x^x)^x$. State the domain assumptions needed for logarithmic differentiation.
step-1994-p1-q2.summaryZh: 设 $a$ 为常数，分别求下列函数关于 $x$ 的导数：（i）$x^a$；（ii）$a^x$；（iii）$x^x$；（iv）$x^{(x^x)}$；（v）$(x^x)^x$。同时说明使用对数微分所需的定义域条件。

methods.title: Take logarithms before differentiating variable powers
methods.titleZh: 先取对数，再对变底变指数幂求导
steps: The ordinary rules give $\frac{d}{dx}x^a=ax^{a-1}$ and, from $a^x=e^{x\ln a}$, $\frac{d}{dx}a^x=a^x\ln a$.
For $y=x^x$, $\ln y=x\ln x$, so $y'/y=1+\ln x$ and $y'=x^x(1+\ln x)$.
For $y=x^{(x^x)}$, $\ln y=x^x\ln x$. The product rule and the previous derivative give $y'/y=x^x\{(1+\ln x)\ln x+x^{-1}\}$, which is the stated expression.

Finally $(x^x)^x=x^{x^2}$. If $y=x^{x^2}$, then $\ln y=x^2\ln x$ and $y'/y=x(1+2\ln x)$, giving the last derivative. Real logarithmic differentiation requires $x>0$; the real expression $a^x$ is treated here with $a>0$.
stepsZh: 普通求导法则给出 $\frac{d}{dx}x^a=ax^{a-1}$。又因 $a^x=e^{x\ln a}$，有 $\frac{d}{dx}a^x=a^x\ln a$。
令 $y=x^x$，则 $\ln y=x\ln x$，所以 $y'/y=1+\ln x$，即 $y'=x^x(1+\ln x)$。
令 $y=x^{(x^x)}$，则 $\ln y=x^x\ln x$。利用乘积法则和上一步的结果，$y'/y=x^x\{(1+\ln x)\ln x+x^{-1}\}$，整理即得答案。
最后，$(x^x)^x=x^{x^2}$。若 $y=x^{x^2}$，则 $\ln y=x^2\ln x$，故 $y'/y=x(1+2\ln x)$。在实数范围内使用上述对数微分需有 $x>0$；这里还取 $a>0$ 以定义一般实指数的 $a^x$。

step-1994-p1-q4.summary: Prove (i) $(1-\cos\alpha)/\sin\alpha=\tan(\alpha/2)$; (ii) for $|k|<1$, integrate $1/(1-2kx+x^2)$. Hence evaluate $\int_0^1 \frac{\sin\alpha}{1-2x\cos\alpha+x^2}\,dx$ for $0<\alpha<\pi$.
step-1994-p1-q4.summaryZh: 证明：（i）$(1-\cos\alpha)/\sin\alpha=\tan(\alpha/2)$；（ii）当 $|k|<1$ 时，求 $1/(1-2kx+x^2)$ 的不定积分。进而在 $0<\alpha<\pi$ 时计算 $\int_0^1 \frac{\sin\alpha}{1-2x\cos\alpha+x^2}\,dx$。
step-1994-p1-q4.answer: The antiderivative is $\frac1{\sqrt{1-k^2}}\tan^{-1}\!\left(\frac{x-k}{\sqrt{1-k^2}}\right)+C$, and the definite integral is $(\pi-\alpha)/2$.
step-1994-p1-q4.answerZh: 不定积分为 $\frac1{\sqrt{1-k^2}}\tan^{-1}\!\left(\frac{x-k}{\sqrt{1-k^2}}\right)+C$，所求定积分为 $(\pi-\alpha)/2$。

methods.title: Use half-angle formulae and complete the square
steps: From $1-\cos\alpha=2\sin^2(\alpha/2)$ and $\sin\alpha=2\sin(\alpha/2)\cos(\alpha/2)$, their quotient is $\tan(\alpha/2)$ whenever it is defined.
Complete the square: $1-2kx+x^2=(x-k)^2+(1-k^2)$. Since $|k|<1$, substituting $x-k=\sqrt{1-k^2}\tan t$ gives the displayed antiderivative.
Put $k=\cos\alpha$. Because $0<\alpha<\pi$, $\sqrt{1-k^2}=\sin\alpha>0$, so the factor in the numerator cancels and the integral equals $[\tan^{-1}((x-\cos\alpha)/\sin\alpha)]_0^1$.

At $x=1$, part (i) gives the argument $\tan(\alpha/2)$, whose inverse tangent is $\alpha/2$. At $x=0$, the argument is $-\cot\alpha=\tan(\alpha-\pi/2)$; the angle $\alpha-\pi/2$ lies in the principal range. The difference is $\alpha/2-(\alpha-\pi/2)=(\pi-\alpha)/2$.
stepsZh: 由 $1-\cos\alpha=2\sin^2(\alpha/2)$ 及 $\sin\alpha=2\sin(\alpha/2)\cos(\alpha/2)$，两式相除即得 $\tan(\alpha/2)$。
配方得 $1-2kx+x^2=(x-k)^2+(1-k^2)$。因 $|k|<1$，令 $x-k=\sqrt{1-k^2}\tan t$，即可得到答案中的反正切原函数。
取 $k=\cos\alpha$。由 $0<\alpha<\pi$，有 $\sqrt{1-k^2}=\sin\alpha>0$，分子中的 $\sin\alpha$ 正好约去，故原积分等于 $[\tan^{-1}((x-\cos\alpha)/\sin\alpha)]_0^1$。
当 $x=1$ 时，由（i）知反正切的自变量为 $\tan(\alpha/2)$，主值为 $\alpha/2$。当 $x=0$ 时，自变量为 $-\cot\alpha=\tan(\alpha-\pi/2)$，且该角在主值区间内。因此结果为 $\alpha/2-(\alpha-\pi/2)=(\pi-\alpha)/2$。

step-1994-p1-q5.summary: On the parabola $y=x^2$, let $P=(p,p^2)$ and $Q=(q,q^2)$ move so that $\angle POQ=90^\circ$. Find and sketch (i) the locus of the midpoint $R$ of $PQ$ and (ii) the locus of the intersection $T$ of the tangents at $P$ and $Q$.
step-1994-p1-q5.summaryZh: 在抛物线 $y=x^2$ 上，点 $P=(p,p^2)$、$Q=(q,q^2)$ 运动并始终满足 $\angle POQ=90^\circ$。求并画出：（i）弦 $PQ$ 中点 $R$ 的轨迹；（ii）$P,Q$ 两点切线交点 $T$ 的轨迹。
step-1994-p1-q5.answer: (i) The whole parabola $y=2x^2+1$, with vertex $(0,1)$. (ii) The whole line $y=-1$. Both loci have unrestricted real $x$.
step-1994-p1-q5.answerZh: （i）完整抛物线 $y=2x^2+1$，顶点为 $(0,1)$；（ii）完整直线 $y=-1$。两条轨迹的横坐标均可取任意实数。

methods.title: Eliminate the two point parameters
steps: The right angle gives $(p,p^2)\cdot(q,q^2)=pq(1+pq)=0$. Neither point can be the origin, so $pq=-1$. Conversely every nonzero $p$ with $q=-1/p$ satisfies the condition.
The tangent at parameter $p$ is $y=2px-p^2$, and similarly for $q$. Their intersection has $x=(p+q)/2$ and $y=pq=-1$.

To check completeness, for any real $s$ the equation $p^2-sp-1=0$ has discriminant $s^2+4>0$ and roots whose product is $-1$. Hence $p+q=s$ can be arbitrary. Thus the sketches are the entire upward parabola with axis the $y$-axis and vertex $(0,1)$, and the entire horizontal line one unit below the $x$-axis.
stepsZh: 直角条件给出 $(p,p^2)\cdot(q,q^2)=pq(1+pq)=0$。由于两点均不能是原点，故 $pq=-1$。反之，任取非零 $p$ 并令 $q=-1/p$ 都满足条件。
参数为 $p$ 的点处切线为 $y=2px-p^2$，参数为 $q$ 时同理。联立两条切线可得交点横坐标 $(p+q)/2$，纵坐标 $pq=-1$。
还需证明轨迹没有缺段。对任意实数 $s$，方程 $p^2-sp-1=0$ 的判别式为 $s^2+4>0$，两根乘积为 $-1$，故 $p+q=s$ 可取任意实数。因此图形分别是顶点 $(0,1)$、对称轴为 $y$ 轴的完整开口向上抛物线，以及位于 $x$ 轴下方一单位的完整水平直线。

step-1994-p1-q6.summary: Define $f(z)=(iz-1)/(iz+1)$ for complex $z$, and let $x$ be real. (i) Find $\operatorname{Re}f(x)$ and $\operatorname{Im}f(x)$. (ii) Show $f(x)f(x)^*=1$. (iii) Find the real and imaginary parts of $f(f(x))$. (iv) Find $f(f(f(x)))$, noting any excluded input.
step-1994-p1-q6.summaryZh: 对复数 $z$ 定义 $f(z)=(iz-1)/(iz+1)$，并设 $x$ 为实数。（i）求 $\operatorname{Re}f(x)$ 与 $\operatorname{Im}f(x)$；（ii）证明 $f(x)f(x)^*=1$；（iii）求 $f(f(x))$ 的实部与虚部；（iv）求 $f(f(f(x)))$，并说明需排除的输入。

methods.title: Rationalise once, then compose algebraically
methods.titleZh: 先用共轭化简，再直接复合函数
steps: Multiply $f(x)$ by $(1-ix)/(1-ix)$. This gives $f(x)=(x^2-1+2ix)/(x^2+1)$, so the real and imaginary parts are as stated.
Their squared moduli sum to $((x^2-1)^2+4x^2)/(x^2+1)^2=1$, proving $f(x)f(x)^*=1$.
For a general $z$, substitute $f(z)$ into $f$ and simplify: $f(f(z))=i(z+1)/(z-1)$. Thus for real $x\ne1$ its real part is $0$ and its imaginary part is $(x+1)/(x-1)$.
Write $y=(x+1)/(x-1)$. Since $f(iy)=(-y-1)/(-y+1)=(y+1)/(y-1)=x$, the third iterate returns $x$. The input $x=1$ must be excluded because $f(1)=i$ and the denominator of $f(i)$ is zero.
stepsZh: 把 $f(x)$ 的分子分母同乘 $1-ix$，得到 $f(x)=(x^2-1+2ix)/(x^2+1)$，从而直接读出实部和虚部。
对一般复数 $z$ 直接代入并化简，可得 $f(f(z))=i(z+1)/(z-1)$。因此当实数 $x\ne1$ 时，实部为 $0$，虚部为 $(x+1)/(x-1)$。

step-1994-p1-q8.summary: By substituting $\theta=\pi/4-\phi$, evaluate $I=\int_0^{\pi/4}\ln(1+\tan\theta)\,d\theta$. Then evaluate $\int_0^1\frac{\ln(1+x)}{1+x^2}\,dx$ and $\int_0^{\pi/2}\ln\!\left(\frac{1+\sin x}{1+\cos x}\right)dx$.
step-1994-p1-q8.summaryZh: 利用代换 $\theta=\pi/4-\phi$ 计算 $I=\int_0^{\pi/4}\ln(1+\tan\theta)\,d\theta$。再求 $\int_0^1\frac{\ln(1+x)}{1+x^2}\,dx$ 以及 $\int_0^{\pi/2}\ln\!\left(\frac{1+\sin x}{1+\cos x}\right)dx$。
step-1994-p1-q8.answer: The three values are respectively $\frac\pi8\ln2$, $\frac\pi8\ln2$, and $0$.
step-1994-p1-q8.answerZh: 三个积分依次为 $\frac\pi8\ln2$、$\frac\pi8\ln2$ 和 $0$。

methods.title: Reflect the interval and reuse the first integral
methods.titleZh: 反射积分区间并复用第一个积分
steps: Under $\theta=\pi/4-\phi$, $1+\tan(\pi/4-\phi)=2/(1+\tan\phi)$. Hence $I=\int_0^{\pi/4}[\ln2-\ln(1+\tan\phi)]\,d\phi=(\pi/4)\ln2-I$, so $I=(\pi/8)\ln2$.
For the second integral put $x=\tan\theta$. Then $dx/(1+x^2)=d\theta$ and the limits become $0$ and $\pi/4$, so it is exactly $I$.
For the last integral, replacing $x$ by $\pi/2-x$ swaps sine and cosine, changes the logarithm to its negative, and preserves the interval. Therefore the integral equals its own negative and is $0$.
Equivalently, with $t=x/2$, $(1+\sin x)/(1+\cos x)=(1+\tan t)^2/2$. The integral becomes $4I-(\pi/2)\ln2=0$, independently confirming the symmetry result.
stepsZh: 作代换 $\theta=\pi/4-\phi$，有 $1+\tan(\pi/4-\phi)=2/(1+\tan\phi)$。故 $I=\int_0^{\pi/4}[\ln2-\ln(1+\tan\phi)]\,d\phi=(\pi/4)\ln2-I$，解得 $I=(\pi/8)\ln2$。
第二个积分令 $x=\tan\theta$，则 $dx/(1+x^2)=d\theta$，上下限变为 $0$ 与 $\pi/4$，所以它恰等于 $I$。
最后一个积分中，用 $\pi/2-x$ 替换 $x$ 会交换正弦与余弦，使对数变号，同时积分区间不变。因此该积分等于自身的相反数，只能为 $0$。
也可令 $t=x/2$，利用 $(1+\sin x)/(1+\cos x)=(1+\tan t)^2/2$，把积分化为 $4I-(\pi/2)\ln2=0$，从而独立核验结果。

step-1994-p1-q9.summary: A projectile is fired at speed $u$. At time $t$ it is at horizontal distance $x$ and height $h$. Derive an equation involving $t,u,g,h,x$. Then, assuming $u^2>2gh$, prove the sharp upper bound for the horizontal range at height $h$ and show that some firing angle attains it.
step-1994-p1-q9.summaryZh: 一物体以初速度大小 $u$ 斜抛。时刻 $t$ 时，它的水平位移为 $x$、高度为 $h$。先推导 $t,u,g,h,x$ 之间的方程；再在 $u^2>2gh$ 下证明物体到达高度 $h$ 时水平距离的最优上界，并证明某个发射角能取到该上界。
step-1994-p1-q9.answer: $\frac14g^2t^4-(u^2-gh)t^2+h^2+x^2=0$, and $x\le u\sqrt{u^2-2gh}/g$. Equality is attained when $\tan\theta=u/\sqrt{u^2-2gh}$.

methods.title: Eliminate the angle and use a discriminant
methods.titleZh: 消去发射角并使用判别式
steps: If the firing angle is $\theta$, then $x=ut\cos\theta$ and $h=ut\sin\theta-gt^2/2$. Thus $ut\cos\theta=x$ and $ut\sin\theta=h+gt^2/2$.
Squaring and adding eliminates $\theta$: $u^2t^2=x^2+(h+gt^2/2)^2$. Rearrangement gives the stated quartic, which is a quadratic in $T=t^2$.
For a real time $T$, its discriminant must be nonnegative: $(u^2-gh)^2-g^2(h^2+x^2)\ge0$. Hence $g^2x^2\le u^2(u^2-2gh)$, yielding the bound.

At equality the quadratic has the positive double root $t^2=2(u^2-gh)/g^2$. Define $\sin\theta=u/(gt)$ and $\cos\theta=\sqrt{u^2-2gh}/(gt)$. Both are nonnegative and their squares sum to $1$, so a firing angle exists; its tangent has the stated value and attains the bound.
stepsZh: 若发射角为 $\theta$，则 $x=ut\cos\theta$，$h=ut\sin\theta-gt^2/2$。所以 $ut\cos\theta=x$，$ut\sin\theta=h+gt^2/2$。
两式平方相加即可消去 $\theta$：$u^2t^2=x^2+(h+gt^2/2)^2$。整理后得到答案中的四次方程；把 $T=t^2$ 看作未知量，它是一个二次方程。
存在实时间要求该二次方程的判别式非负，即 $(u^2-gh)^2-g^2(h^2+x^2)\ge0$。于是 $g^2x^2\le u^2(u^2-2gh)$，得到所需上界。
取等时二次方程有正的二重根 $t^2=2(u^2-gh)/g^2$。令 $\sin\theta=u/(gt)$、$\cos\theta=\sqrt{u^2-2gh}/(gt)$；两者非负且平方和为 $1$，故确有相应发射角。其正切值如答案所示，且水平距离达到上界。

step-1994-p1-q10.summary: A particle of mass $m$ is attached to a light elastic string of natural length $l$ and modulus $\lambda$, whose other end is fixed at $A$. It moves in a horizontal circle with angular speed $\omega$; the string makes angle $\theta$ with the downward vertical. Find $\cos\theta$ and determine exactly when this non-degenerate circular motion is possible.
step-1994-p1-q10.summaryZh: 质量为 $m$ 的质点连接在一根原长为 $l$、弹性模量为 $\lambda$ 的轻弹性绳一端，另一端固定于 $A$。质点以角速度 $\omega$ 作水平圆周运动，绳与竖直向下方向夹角为 $\theta$。求 $\cos\theta$，并确定这种非退化圆周运动存在的充要条件。
step-1994-p1-q10.answer: $\displaystyle \cos\theta=\frac{g(\lambda-m\omega^2l)}{l\lambda\omega^2}$, and motion is possible exactly when $\displaystyle \frac{g\lambda}{l(\lambda+mg)}<\omega^2<\frac{\lambda}{ml}$.

methods.title: Resolve the tension and impose Hooke's law
methods.titleZh: 分解张力并结合胡克定律
steps: Let the extension be $e$ and the tension be $T=\lambda e/l$. The actual string length is $l+e$, so the circle radius is $(l+e)\sin\theta$.
Vertical balance and horizontal circular motion give $T\cos\theta=mg$ and $T\sin\theta=m\omega^2(l+e)\sin\theta$. For a genuine circle $\sin\theta\ne0$, hence $T=m\omega^2(l+e)$.

Combining this with Hooke's law gives $e=m\omega^2l^2/(\lambda-m\omega^2l)$ and $T=m\omega^2l\lambda/(\lambda-m\omega^2l)$. Substitution into the vertical equation yields the formula for $\cos\theta$.

A circle below $A$ requires $0<\cos\theta<1$. Positivity gives $\omega^2<\lambda/(ml)$; the inequality $\cos\theta<1$ rearranges to $\omega^2>g\lambda/[l(\lambda+mg)]$. Conversely these two strict inequalities make the extension positive and give a unique $0<\theta<\pi/2$, so they are sufficient as well.
stepsZh: 设绳的伸长量为 $e$，张力为 $T=\lambda e/l$。绳的实际长度是 $l+e$，故水平圆的半径为 $(l+e)\sin\theta$。
竖直方向平衡、水平向心运动分别给出 $T\cos\theta=mg$ 与 $T\sin\theta=m\omega^2(l+e)\sin\theta$。非退化圆周运动满足 $\sin\theta\ne0$，所以 $T=m\omega^2(l+e)$。
与胡克定律联立可得 $e=m\omega^2l^2/(\lambda-m\omega^2l)$，进而 $T=m\omega^2l\lambda/(\lambda-m\omega^2l)$。代回竖直方向方程，即得 $\cos\theta$ 的公式。
圆周位于 $A$ 下方要求 $0<\cos\theta<1$。正性给出 $\omega^2<\lambda/(ml)$；而 $\cos\theta<1$ 化简为 $\omega^2>g\lambda/[l(\lambda+mg)]$。反之，这两个严格不等式使伸长量为正，并唯一确定 $0<\theta<\pi/2$，所以条件也是充分的。

step-1994-p1-q11.summary: A wagon $A$ of mass $m$ rests at the foot of a smooth track of length $d$ inclined at angle $\theta$. A light string of length $d$ passes over a frictionless pulley at the top and supports a hanging ball $B$ of mass $M$. After release, (i) find the condition for the ball to reach the ground and its impact speed; (ii) find the condition for the wagon not to collide with the pulley.
step-1994-p1-q11.summaryZh: 质量为 $m$ 的小车 $A$ 位于长为 $d$、倾角为 $\theta$ 的光滑斜轨底端。一根长为 $d$ 的轻绳跨过顶端光滑轻滑轮，另一端悬挂质量为 $M$ 的球 $B$。释放系统后：（i）求球落地的条件及落地速度；（ii）求小车不与顶端滑轮发生碰撞的条件。
step-1994-p1-q11.answer: (i) $M>m\sin\theta$ and $v^2=2g(M-m\sin\theta)d\sin\theta/(M+m)$. (ii) Given (i), no positive-speed collision occurs iff $M\sin\theta\le m$, i.e. $m\sin\theta<M\le m/\sin\theta$; equality means the wagon only reaches the pulley at rest.
step-1994-p1-q11.answerZh: （i）$M>m\sin\theta$，且 $v^2=2g(M-m\sin\theta)d\sin\theta/(M+m)$。（ii）在（i）成立时，不以正速度碰撞滑轮当且仅当 $M\sin\theta\le m$，即 $m\sin\theta<M\le m/\sin\theta$；等号时小车恰以零速度到达滑轮。

methods.title: Separate the taut-string and slack-string phases
methods.titleZh: 分开处理绳绷紧与绳松弛两个阶段
steps: While the string is taut, let the ball accelerate downward and the wagon upward along the track with acceleration $a$. The equations are $Mg-T=Ma$ and $T-mg\sin\theta=ma$, so $a=g(M-m\sin\theta)/(M+m)$. Thus the ball descends only if $M>m\sin\theta$.
The pulley is at height $d\sin\theta$, so the ball falls that distance before reaching the ground. Starting from rest, $v^2=2a(d\sin\theta)$, giving the stated expression.

At impact the wagon has travelled $d\sin\theta$ up the track and retains speed $v$. The ball stops and the string becomes slack; the wagon then decelerates at $g\sin\theta$ and travels a further $s=v^2/(2g\sin\theta)=(M-m\sin\theta)d/(M+m)$.

The remaining track length is $d(1-\sin\theta)$. The condition $s<d(1-\sin\theta)$ simplifies to $M\sin\theta<m$. Equality means arrival at the pulley with zero speed, not a positive-speed collision. Combining with the falling condition gives the interval in the answer; if 'not reach the pulley' is intended, the upper inequality is strict.
stepsZh: 绳保持绷紧时，设球向下、小车沿斜面向上的加速度均为 $a$。列方程 $Mg-T=Ma$、$T-mg\sin\theta=ma$，相加得 $a=g(M-m\sin\theta)/(M+m)$。因此球能下降的条件是 $M>m\sin\theta$。
滑轮离地高度为 $d\sin\theta$，故球落地前下降这一距离。由静止开始，$v^2=2a(d\sin\theta)$，代入 $a$ 即得答案中的速度公式。
球落地时，小车已沿轨道上升 $d\sin\theta$，速度仍为 $v$。随后球停止、绳松弛，小车只受沿斜面向下的重力分量，以 $g\sin\theta$ 减速，再上行 $s=v^2/(2g\sin\theta)=(M-m\sin\theta)d/(M+m)$。
此时余下轨道长 $d(1-\sin\theta)$。要求 $s<d(1-\sin\theta)$，化简得 $M\sin\theta<m$。等号时小车仅以零速度到达滑轮，并非正速度碰撞。与球落地条件合并即得答案区间；若题意要求“不能到达滑轮”，则上端也应取严格不等号。

step-1994-p1-q13.summary: A bag contains $M$ tokens, $m$ red. Draw $n$ without replacement. Let $X_i$ indicate whether draw $i$ is red and let $X$ be the number of red tokens drawn. Relate $X$ to the indicators, find $E(X_i)$ and $E(X)$, derive the distribution of $X$, and deduce a weighted binomial-coefficient identity.
step-1994-p1-q13.summaryZh: 袋中有 $M$ 个筹码，其中 $m$ 个为红色；无放回抽取 $n$ 个。令 $X_i$ 表示第 $i$ 次抽到红色与否，$X$ 为抽出的红色筹码总数。写出 $X$ 与各指示变量的关系，求 $E(X_i)$、$E(X)$ 和 $X$ 的分布，并推出一个带权二项式系数恒等式。
step-1994-p1-q13.answer: $X=\sum_{i=1}^nX_i$, $E(X_i)=m/M$, $E(X)=mn/M$, and $P(X=k)=\binom mk\binom{M-m}{n-k}/\binom Mn$. Hence $\sum_{k=1}^n k\binom mk\binom{M-m}{n-k}=m\binom{M-1}{n-1}$.

methods.title: Use indicators, then compute the same expectation twice
methods.titleZh: 使用指示变量，再从两种方式计算同一期望
steps: Each red draw contributes $1$ to exactly one indicator and every other draw contributes $0$, so $X=X_1+\cdots+X_n$.

By symmetry, the token in any fixed draw position is uniformly distributed among the $M$ tokens. Thus $E(X_i)=P(X_i=1)=m/M$. Linearity of expectation, which does not require independent draws, gives $E(X)=mn/M$.

Every $n$-token subset is equally likely. Exactly $k$ reds can be chosen in $\binom mk\binom{M-m}{n-k}$ ways, out of $\binom Mn$ total subsets, giving the hypergeometric probability. Impossible values are automatically zero under the usual binomial-coefficient convention.
Now compute $E(X)=\sum_{k=1}^n kP(X=k)$ and equate it to $mn/M$. Multiplying by $\binom Mn$ and using $(n/M)\binom Mn=\binom{M-1}{n-1}$ yields the required identity.
stepsZh: 每抽到一个红色筹码，恰有一个指示变量贡献 $1$；非红色抽取贡献 $0$。因此 $X=X_1+\cdots+X_n$。
由对称性，任意固定抽取位置上的筹码都等可能是 $M$ 个筹码中的任意一个，所以 $E(X_i)=P(X_i=1)=m/M$。期望的线性性不要求各次抽取独立，故 $E(X)=mn/M$。
所有大小为 $n$ 的筹码子集等可能。恰含 $k$ 个红色筹码的选法数为 $\binom mk\binom{M-m}{n-k}$，总选法为 $\binom Mn$，于是得到超几何概率；按通常约定，不可行的二项式系数为零。
另一方面，$E(X)=\sum_{k=1}^n kP(X=k)$。把它与 $mn/M$ 相等，乘以 $\binom Mn$，再用 $(n/M)\binom Mn=\binom{M-1}{n-1}$，即可得到所需恒等式。

step-1994-p1-q14.summary: The independent submission times $T_1,\ldots,T_n$ have density $\lambda e^{-\lambda t}$ for $t>0$. Let $T=\min_iT_i$ be the first submission time and $U=\max_iT_i$ the last. Find the mean and variance of each $T_i$, the distribution and density of $U$, the survival function and density of $T$, and then the mean and variance of $T$.
step-1994-p1-q14.summaryZh: 独立的交稿时间 $T_1,\ldots,T_n$ 在 $t>0$ 上的密度为 $\lambda e^{-\lambda t}$。令 $T=\min_iT_i$ 为最早交稿时间，$U=\max_iT_i$ 为最晚交稿时间。求每个 $T_i$ 的均值与方差、$U$ 的分布函数和密度、$T$ 的生存函数和密度，以及 $T$ 的均值与方差。
step-1994-p1-q14.answer: $E(T_i)=1/\lambda$, $\operatorname{Var}(T_i)=1/\lambda^2$; $F_U(u)=(1-e^{-\lambda u})^n$ and $f_U(u)=n\lambda e^{-\lambda u}(1-e^{-\lambda u})^{n-1}$; $P(T>t)=e^{-n\lambda t}$, $f_T(t)=n\lambda e^{-n\lambda t}$, $E(T)=1/(n\lambda)$, $\operatorname{Var}(T)=1/(n^2\lambda^2)$.
step-1994-p1-q14.answerZh: $E(T_i)=1/\lambda$，$\operatorname{Var}(T_i)=1/\lambda^2$；$F_U(u)=(1-e^{-\lambda u})^n$，$f_U(u)=n\lambda e^{-\lambda u}(1-e^{-\lambda u})^{n-1}$；$P(T>t)=e^{-n\lambda t}$，$f_T(t)=n\lambda e^{-n\lambda t}$，$E(T)=1/(n\lambda)$，$\operatorname{Var}(T)=1/(n^2\lambda^2)$。

methods.title: Turn extrema into intersections of independent events
methods.titleZh: 把最大值与最小值事件化为独立事件的交集
steps: For one exponential variable, integration by parts gives $E(T_i)=\int_0^\infty t\lambda e^{-\lambda t}dt=1/\lambda$ and $E(T_i^2)=2/\lambda^2$, hence variance $1/\lambda^2$.
The event $U\le u$ means every $T_i\le u$. Since $P(T_i\le u)=1-e^{-\lambda u}$ and the variables are independent, $F_U(u)=(1-e^{-\lambda u})^n$ for $u\ge0$. Differentiation gives the stated density.

The event $T>t$ means every $T_i>t$. Each has survival probability $e^{-\lambda t}$, so independence gives $P(T>t)=e^{-n\lambda t}$. Thus $F_T(t)=1-e^{-n\lambda t}$ and $f_T(t)=n\lambda e^{-n\lambda t}$ for $t\ge0$.
Therefore $T$ itself is exponential with rate $n\lambda$. Replacing $\lambda$ by $n\lambda$ in the first step gives its mean and variance. All densities are $0$ on negative arguments.
stepsZh: 对单个指数随机变量分部积分，得 $E(T_i)=\int_0^\infty t\lambda e^{-\lambda t}dt=1/\lambda$，又有 $E(T_i^2)=2/\lambda^2$，故方差为 $1/\lambda^2$。
事件 $U\le u$ 等价于所有 $T_i\le u$。单个变量满足 $P(T_i\le u)=1-e^{-\lambda u}$，再由独立性得 $F_U(u)=(1-e^{-\lambda u})^n$（$u\ge0$）。对其求导即得密度。
事件 $T>t$ 等价于所有 $T_i>t$。每个变量的生存概率为 $e^{-\lambda t}$，故独立性给出 $P(T>t)=e^{-n\lambda t}$。于是 $F_T(t)=1-e^{-n\lambda t}$，$f_T(t)=n\lambda e^{-n\lambda t}$（$t\ge0$）。
因此 $T$ 本身服从参数为 $n\lambda$ 的指数分布。把第一步中的 $\lambda$ 替换为 $n\lambda$，即可读出其均值与方差。所有密度在负数处均为 $0$。
